subject.title: [Feature]: Add one-way dispatch mode for A2A handoffs without reply-back ping-pong

question: Should one-way A2A handoff be added as a `sessions_send` dispatch mode, as a separate one-way primitive, or deferred while only narrower ping-pong/reverse-call bugs are fixed?
rationale: The requested behavior is still missing, but it changes model-facing session semantics and compatibility for existing A2A workflows, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape.

options.title: Add explicit dispatch mode
options.body: Extend `sessions_send` with a clearly named one-way mode that keeps current conversation behavior as the default and documents/tests both modes.

options.title: Create a separate primitive
options.body: Add a `sessions_deliver` or `sessions_enqueue` style tool so one-way handoff cannot be confused with conversational `sessions_send`.

options.title: Defer dispatch semantics
options.body: Keep the current conversation lifecycle and continue handling narrower reverse-call, loop, and announce issues separately.

recommendation.title: Add explicit dispatch mode
recommendation.body: Extend `sessions_send` with a clearly named one-way mode that keeps current conversation behavior as the default and documents/tests both modes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal across the central sessions_send tool and A2A behavior surface.
